title: Tableau sources precede the base
statement: For every finite-state Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input and output and all natural numbers $n,t$, every index in the source list used to construct the tableau at time $t$ is strictly less than the tableau base $n+2+tW$, where $W$ is the tableau width determined by $M$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine $M$ over Boolean symbols
